note: The original is in German and was extracted from the OCR text of a library scan on Internet Archive (archive.org item biostor-232733); individual digits and letters are misrecognised and were checked against the context and the plate captions; digits that could not be confirmed were not entered. The original description covers the wingless reproductive, the soldier and three worker types (the medium worker is inferred in the original to be a pathological individual).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (the wingless king) Body length 5—7 mm, head length 1.57 mm, head width 1.4 mm. Posterior part of the head brown, anterior part rusty yellow, densely hairy; nota rusty brown; abdominal tergites brown, sternites rusty yellow; legs rusty yellow; thorax and abdomen (especially the posterior margins of the sclerites) very densely hairy. Head without a fontanelle. Ocelli oval, close to the compound eyes and lateral to them. On each side of the base of the frontal band an obliquely placed small pale spot, and near the anterior corner another large pale spot. Basal part of the clypeus medially concave, narrow, band-like; apical part white, wider, the lateral angles slightly projecting, the anterior margin arcuate. Labrum tongue-shaped. Mandibles as in the worker. Antennal segment 3 longer than segment 2 and also longer than segment 4. Pronotum with a notch on both the anterior and the posterior margin, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin rounded.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The queen has a body length of 21 mm and an abdominal width of 5.5 mm. The nest is a carton nest from fist- to child's-head-sized, built in bamboo and Gynerium clumps on river banks, of the same type as Eutermes chaquimayensis; it is usually built around the stems of bamboo or Gynerium, and its surface is very smooth; the hard central core is walnut-sized and contains the royal cell, in which there are usually more than 1 queen (mostly 2), accompanied by 2 kings, or both attended by 1 king; in one nest 1 queen and 2 kings were seen. Localities: San José and San Fermín, Caupolicán province, Bolivia; Chaquimayo, Carabaya province, Peru.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 3.6 mm, head length 1.4 mm, head width 0.72 mm. Head rusty brown, the frons with several setae; pronotum pale straw yellow, the anterior margin slightly darker and with several setae; abdomen grey-white; tergites covered with a layer of almost microscopic fine hairs, the posterior margins with long setae; sternites with a covering of short hairs and longer setae on the posterior margin. Head oval (plate M1), the frontal process conical; the outline of the frons has a swelling in the middle. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 shorter than segment 3, segment 3 equal in length to segment 4 but narrower. Anterior margin of the pronotum rising.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: body length 4.3—4.5 mm. Posterior part of the head brown, anterior part rusty yellow or straw yellow; head with fine hairs, the coronal suture distinct and pale; thorax and abdomen straw yellow, the gut contents visible through the abdomen; tergites with fine hairs, each sclerite with single setae on its posterior margin, the ventral hair covering denser. Head round, the fontanelle slightly elongate; the widest part of the head behind the antennae; anterior margin of the frontal band rather deeply concave, on each side a raised shining dot; basal part of the clypeus swollen, lens-shaped, divided in the middle; apical part indistinct; labrum tongue-shaped; left mandible with 2 pointed teeth, the middle tooth and the 2nd pointed tooth forming an arcuate cutting edge, the basal tooth large; right mandible with a well-developed pointed tooth, the middle tooth with a square tip, the basal tooth with a long masticatory edge bearing small tubercles. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 about equal in length to segment 3, segment 4 smaller than segment 3, segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 3 but wider. Anterior margin of the pronotum strongly rising. Medium worker (apparently a pathological individual): body length 3.3 mm, head length 1.35 mm, head width 1.2 mm; darker than the large worker, the abdominal hair covering slightly denser; fontanelle indistinct; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about half of segment 2, segment 4 about half of segment 3. Small worker: body length 3.3 mm, head length 0.85 mm, head width 0.75 mm; posterior part of the head pale rusty brown, anterior part grey-white or pale straw yellow, scattered with short setae; abdomen high, the fine setal covering as in the large worker; gut contents visible as grey-brown; on each side of the frontal band a raised round shining dot; coronal suture distinct; fontanelle large, triangular; mandibles as in the large worker. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 and segment 3 of equal size, segment 4 shorter than segment 3.
